newsitem.title: FRANCE: Text of French statement on Thomson sale.
newsitem.headline: Text of French statement on Thomson sale.

text.p: The following is a Reuters translation of a statement by the finance, industry and defence ministries on its decision to sell Thomson-CSF by private placement:
The government has decided on the privatisation of Thomson-CSF via a private placement with a book of terms and conditions.

This procedure meets the goal of building quickly around Thomson-CSF, in full respect of its culture and identity, a world-size grouping of professional industrial electronics and defence able to compete on the international stage.

This industrial grouping must have, after privatisation, the best technologies for all the activities involved in defence electronics, adequate research and development capacity, and a reinforced financial capacity, with the aim of setting up a flourishing industrial pillar for European firms in this sector.

That is why the government would like to gather as wide as possible a grouping of industrial businesses so that they can contribute in the best conditions possible, to the restructuring of the European defence industry. In this spirit, it is open to the participation of French and European industrial players in this sector in the construction by stages of a great defence electronics company around Thomson-CSF.

In line with the conditions fixed by the law on privatisation, the state will retain a special share in the capital of Thomson-CSF allowing it to protect national defence interests and avoid any dismantling of the company.

As authorised by the law on privatisation, a part of Thomson's capital will be set aside for its employees. Ten percent of shares sold at this time will be set aside for employees of Thomson-CSF and its subsidiaries under conditions similar to those applying to a public sale offer.

The book of terms and conditions setting the conditions of the procedure and criteria will be transmitted soon to the Privatisation Commission for its approval before the official launching of a tender by announcement in the Official Journal . The government will ensure that the greatest transparency is applied to this procedure, while protecting the strategic and commercial interests of the company.
The company will be associated as closely as possible to the privatisation procedure.
